subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these grouped executable action revisions, including Codex Action safety and permission-profile changes, in workflows with secrets and elevated permissions?
rationale: The protected security label and material third-party executable changes require explicit owner trust beyond the mechanical assertion repairs.

options.title: Approve Verified Batch
options.body: Accept the revisions after assertion repair, upstream source review, and exact-head workflow validation are complete.

options.title: Split Sensitive Updates
options.body: Review Codex Action, token generation, Docker publishing, and CodeQL changes separately from setup-only actions.

options.title: Retain Current Pins
options.body: Decline the grouped update if maintainers do not accept the combined supply-chain change.

recommendation.title: Approve Verified Batch
recommendation.body: Accept the revisions after assertion repair, upstream source review, and exact-head workflow validation are complete.
